This plot is not mine — I rent it, so I don't want to put too much money into chemical fertilizer when the landlord could change terms next season. For cassava and yam here in the South South, we mostly use cuttings from last year's harvest and some manure from the compound. The forest soil still holds, and chemical fertilizer is expensive and not easy to find close by. I will do most of the work myself but call on one or two people to help clear and mound the land.
